name: mind-diary
description: Connect the Mind Diary UAT pilot and work with your private, revisioned knowledge spaces.

interface.shortDescription: Browse and update Minds in the UAT pilot.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the restricted Mind Diary UAT pilot with OAuth on first use. Attach explicit read-only Minds, choose one writable Mind, and browse, search, fetch, validate, export, safely commit Markdown Memories, or apply an already enabled routine automatic-capture policy. Every write preserves immutable history and uses binding plus revision concurrency.
defaultPrompt: Show the Minds I can access
Search one Mind for a Memory
Add a Memory to my Personal Mind
